page_title: WOL 0-2 BOU | Wolves v Bournemouth 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+6' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+5' Matheus Mane (Wolves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+5' A cross from Pedro Lima (Wolves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+4' The game has come to an end for Adam Smith. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Bafode Diakite (Bournemouth).
90+4' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' Matheus Mane (Wolves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+1' 0 - 2 It's 0:2! Rayan feeds Alex Scott (Bournemouth) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top left corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedro Lima (Wolves) replacing Santiago Bueno.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Bueno leaves the pitch and David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) comes on.
88' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to James Hill (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
87' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
86' Here is a change. Alejandro Jimenez is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Alex Toth (Bournemouth).
85' Evanilson goes off the pitch and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) comes on.
85' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
82' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
82' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Joao Gomes (Wolves) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post!
81' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

81' A lofted cross from Jhon Arias (Wolves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
80' A substitution has been made. Andre goes off and Jhon Arias (Wolves) comes on.
80' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar.
79' Rayan (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' Joao Gomes (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
76' Evanilson (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
75' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Joao Gomes (Wolves) receives a yellow card!
72' A rebound spins to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
72' Matheus Mane (Wolves) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
71' The substitution is prepared. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Gomes.
70' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) replaces Hee-Chan Hwang.
70' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call.
68' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but Jose Sa punches the ball away.
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amine Adli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rayan (Bournemouth).
68' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Eli Junior Kroupi will be replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
67' Matheus Mane (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
62' The resulting corner from Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
57' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
56' A raking crossfield pass from Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
55' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) sprays a pass out to Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
53' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
49' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
47' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

46' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Jose Sa. Bournemouth get a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Andre (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jose Sa is well positioned and punches the ball away.
43' A dangerous looking corner kick from Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is cleared to safety by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
43' A pass from Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Jose Sa and the move breaks down. The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
41' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
39' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joao Gomes (Wolves).
36' Andre (Wolves) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
36' The ball is cleared after Matheus Mane (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

33' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Amine Adli, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
30' A pass finds the feet of Matheus Mane (Wolves) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
29' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

28' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
26' Matheus Mane (Wolves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
25' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
24' This shall not pass! Matheus Mane (Wolves) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
23' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
19' Matheus Mane (Wolves) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
18' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) and Eli Junior Kroupi attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
16' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

16' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Oliver with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Wolves, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
13' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
12' Evanilson (Bournemouth) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
10' The free kick is delivered by Matheus Mane (Wolves) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
8' A goal, which was scored by Matheus Mane (Wolves), was disallowed due to offside.
6' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
5' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Amine Adli (Bournemouth), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
3' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Andre (Wolves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
2' Matheus Mane (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
1' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will referee today's match.
